授業概要
総合歯科学の臨床体系の発展に資するべく治療法、器材等の開発に向け、臨床の実践を基盤とした研究を行う。
To contribute to the development of the clinical system of Interdisciplinary Dentistry, Ph.D candidate will conduct research based on clinical practice toward the development of treatment methods and equipment.
